SELECT NVL(SUM(amount), 0) AS refund_amount FROM refunds WHERE status = 1
SELECT COUNT(*) AS month_payment_count FROM payments WHERE status = 1 AND paid >= TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM') AND paid < ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM'), 1)
SELECT NVL(SUM(amount), 0) AS payment_amount FROM payments WHERE status = 1 AND paid >= TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM') AND paid < ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM'), 1)
SELECT NVL(SUM(amount), 0) AS refund_amount FROM refunds WHERE status = 1 AND completed >= TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM') AND completed < ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM'), 1)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS quarter_payment_count FROM payments WHERE status = 1 AND paid >= TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'Q') AND paid < ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'Q'), 3)
SELECT NVL(SUM(amount), 0) AS quarter_payment_amount FROM payments WHERE status = 1 AND paid >= TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'Q') AND paid < ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'Q'), 3)
SELECT NVL(SUM(amount), 0) AS quarter_refund_amount FROM refunds WHERE status = 1 AND completed >= TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'Q') AND completed < ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'Q'), 3)

WITH months AS ( SELECT TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM'), LEVEL - 6), 'YYYY-MM') AS month FROM dual CONNECT BY LEVEL <= 6 ), payment_monthly AS ( SELECT TO_CHAR(paid, 'YYYY-MM') AS month, NVL(SUM(amount), 0) AS payment_amount FROM payments WHERE status = 1 AND paid >= ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM'), -5) AND paid < ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM'), 1) GROUP BY TO_CHAR(paid, 'YYYY-MM') ), refund_monthly AS ( SELECT TO_CHAR(completed, 'YYYY-MM') AS month, NVL(SUM(amount), 0) AS refund_amount FROM refunds WHERE status = 1 AND completed >= ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM'), -5) AND completed < ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM'), 1) GROUP BY TO_CHAR(completed, 'YYYY-MM') ) SELECT m.month, NVL(p.payment_amount, 0) AS payment_amount, NVL(r.refund_amount, 0) AS refund_amount, NVL(p.payment_amount, 0) - NVL(r.refund_amount, 0) AS net_amount FROM months m LEFT JOIN payment_monthly p ON m.month = p.month LEFT JOIN refund_monthly r ON m.month = r.month ORDER BY m.month
